scenario.device: Desktop Chromium 1350 px + 375 px mobile emulation
scenario.stopRule: Stopped at the first screen asking for personal data, an account, or payment

carriers.name: EMX

journey.detail: Emirates, type, weight, value, box size
Pickup slot, name, email, phones, map pin

strengths: Box-size presets fill L × W × H for you
Booking page is the fastest of the four (Lighthouse 98 mobile)
Shows an estimated delivery date with the price
Stepper collapses to “1 of 5” on mobile

carriers.name: Aramex

journey.detail: Hero is tracking only; Rate Calculator further down
Country, cities, zip codes, value, boxes, weight, L × W × H

strengths: Price shown tax-inclusive with the tax amount
Live “total chargeable weight” as you type
Zip fields switch off once UAE is chosen

carriers.name: DHL Express

journey.detail: “Get a Rate and Time Quote” tab
Packaging, quantity, weight, L × W × H

strengths: Says “No account needed – pay with a credit card” up front
Explains documents vs packages where you choose
Links prohibited items for the lane

carriers.name: FedEx

metrics.outcome: Sign-in wall after choosing a rate

journey.detail: Revealed after addresses: packaging, weight, dims, date

strengths: Fewest fields to a price (3 filled)
One smart address field replaces country/city/zip
Metric units default on the UAE site
Progressive disclosure keeps the first screen short

issues.title: “Send a Shipment” button opens the Card Services page
issues.evidence: Homepage link href is /CardServicesSolutions while the tile next to it points to products.emx.ae/sendshipment.

issues.title: Two different 5-step models on the same screen
issues.evidence: Stepper: Shipment Details → Service Type → Sender → Receiver → Review. Side panel: Origin & Destination → Describe → Price → Sender & Receiver → Booking.

issues.title: Price card does not say what AED 25.00 includes
issues.evidence: No VAT, pickup or insurance statement on the card. Inclusions sit behind “Details & Benefits”. Aramex states “Price including taxes”.

issues.title: Phone code list shows ~240 bare dial codes with no country names
issues.evidence: Options read “+93, +358, +355 …” in an unsorted order. Repeated for the alternate number.

issues.title: Weight, value and dimensions open the full text keyboard
issues.evidence: Inputs are type="text" with no inputmode, so phones show letters instead of a number pad.

issues.title: Name and email fields cannot be autofilled
issues.evidence: first_name, last_name and email_address have no autocomplete tokens.

issues.title: Emirate pickers and Shipment Value have no programmatic label
issues.evidence: react-select inputs and the value field expose no label or aria-label to screen readers.

issues.title: Homepage, the way into booking, is slow and jumpy on phones
issues.evidence: Lighthouse mobile: Performance 29, LCP 13.8 s, CLS 0.38, 4.3 MB transferred.

issues.title: Domestic / International cards fill the first phone screen
issues.evidence: At 375 px the first input starts about 720 px down.

issues.title: Quote is a secondary tile; the hero leads with tracking
issues.evidence: Hero offers Track; “Get Rates” and “Send Shipment” sit in a tile row below.

issues.title: Booking footer reads “© 2024”
issues.evidence: Stale year on a payment journey weakens trust.

issues.title: SHIELD protection is pre-ticked and raises the total by 52%
issues.evidence: Base AED 48.00 + SHIELD AED 25.00 checked by default = AED 73.00.

issues.title: Length, width and height look optional, are required, and fail off-screen
issues.evidence: Labels have no asterisk. On submit the page scrolls to the top and the three errors render out of view.

issues.title: No guest booking: sign-in wall after the quote
issues.evidence: “Create Shipment Now” redirects to login.aramex.com, which pre-lists two common login errors.

issues.title: UAE site does not preselect UAE and asks for zip codes
issues.evidence: Domestic tab starts at “Select country” (list opens at Afghanistan). Zip Code shows as required until a country is set; the UAE has no postcodes.

issues.title: “Send a Shipment” links go to two different URLs
issues.evidence: /ship/send-shipments in the menu, /ship/send-a-shipment in the page body.

issues.title: Small inputs zoom the page on iPhone; CTA is two screens down
issues.evidence: 9 of 11 inputs use 14 px text (iOS zooms below 16 px). Get Rates sits ~1,600 px down behind a decorative image.

issues.title: Homepage hero is tracking only
issues.evidence: No quote or ship CTA above the fold; Rate Calculator is a lower section card.

issues.title: Slow homepage on mobile
issues.evidence: Lighthouse mobile: Performance 39, LCP 9.4 s, Best Practices 50.

issues.title: Country list opened empty on first load
issues.evidence: Typing found no options until the page was reloaded. Observed once.

issues.title: Get Quote returns no rates and no message
issues.evidence: Two attempts on the UAE domestic lane. The page stays put; the console shows a 404 from the address lookup.

issues.title: Pre-filled weight turns “2” into 0.52 kg
issues.evidence: Choosing “My Own Package” fills 0.5 kg; typing appends to it with no warning.

issues.title: Phones are sent to a country and language picker first
issues.evidence: The /ae/en quote link redirects to /index/en/mobile.html: “Select Country/Territory”, “Select Language”, Next.

issues.title: UAE not preset; emirate is called “Province”
issues.evidence: Country starts empty on the UAE site; the homepage widget truncates the label to “Countr…”.

issues.title: Legal liability paragraph dominates the package step
issues.evidence: A 60-word GCAA warning sits above the inputs before any price is shown.

issues.title: Heavy, shifting booking page
issues.evidence: Lighthouse: mobile LCP 14.2 s; desktop CLS 0.27 and 6.9 MB transferred.

issues.title: Wrong country committed when the suggestion list closed
issues.evidence: Destination silently became “Afghanistan”; only a red border signalled it. Observed once.

issues.title: Rate shows no delivery date
issues.evidence: “Arrives on --” and “Delivered by --” next to AED 100.72.

issues.title: No guest booking: choosing a rate opens sign-in
issues.evidence: Clicking the price goes to /secure-login/en-ae.

issues.title: Account promo sits between the form and the rates
issues.evidence: “Sign up now and save up to 55%” banner with OPEN AN ACCOUNT pushes rates below the fold.

issues.title: Pickup is pre-ticked with no price impact shown
issues.evidence: “I want this shipment picked up” is checked by default.

issues.title: Raw translation key exposed
issues.evidence: Page text includes “loadingIndicator.loadingComplete”.

issues.title: Rate page is the slowest page audited
issues.evidence: Lighthouse mobile: Performance 11, LCP 27.0 s, TBT 2.8 s. Homepage transfers ~20 MB.

issues.title: L × W × H inputs share one label
issues.evidence: The three dimension inputs have no individual accessible names.

recommendations.title: Repoint “Send a Shipment” to the booking flow
recommendations.detail: One-line link fix on the homepage. Today it sends booking intent to Card Services.

recommendations.title: Make guest booking and “no pre-ticked extras” a stated promise
recommendations.detail: Aramex and FedEx force sign-in and pre-tick extras. Say “No account needed” on the price card and keep add-ons opt-in.

recommendations.title: Mobile input hygiene pass
recommendations.detail: inputmode="decimal" on numbers, autocomplete tokens on name/email/tel, labels on custom selects.

recommendations.title: Price card that answers “what am I paying for?”
recommendations.detail: “AED 25.00 incl. VAT · pickup included · delivered by Sat 31 Oct”, with the main inclusions visible, not behind a link.

recommendations.title: Searchable country picker for phone codes
recommendations.detail: Default +971 with flag and country name; search by name or code.

recommendations.title: Compact mobile start
recommendations.detail: Swap the two large cards for a segmented Domestic | International control and add a sticky Calculate bar.

recommendations.title: One step model
recommendations.detail: Rename the side-panel steps to match the stepper, or remove the panel once the form starts.

recommendations.title: Quote starter in the homepage hero
recommendations.detail: From emirate, To emirate, weight. Carry the values into step 1 of the wizard.

recommendations.title: Homepage mobile speed budget
recommendations.detail: Resize and compress the hero, set image dimensions, defer third-party scripts. Target LCP < 2.5 s and CLS < 0.1.

recommendations.title: Save or share this quote
recommendations.detail: Let undecided users email the quote to themselves or copy a link that restores it.

recommendations.title: Refresh footer year and stale copy
recommendations.detail: Small trust signal on a payment journey.

abTests.name: Quote starter in the hero
abTests.hypothesis: Putting From, To and weight in the homepage hero will raise quote starts, because booking intent no longer has to find a secondary tile.
abTests.control: Current hero: tracking field, quote as a tile below
abTests.variant: Hero with three fields and a “Get price” button that deep-links into step 1 with values filled
abTests.primary: Sessions that reach the price step ÷ homepage sessions

abTests.name: Transparent price card
abTests.hypothesis: Stating VAT, pickup and the delivery date on the card, plus “No account needed”, will move more people from price to sender details.
abTests.control: “Express Service · Estimated delivery · AED 25.00 · Details & Benefits”
abTests.variant: “AED 25.00 incl. VAT · Pickup included · Delivered by Sat 31 Oct · No account needed”

abTests.name: Mobile form ergonomics
abTests.hypothesis: A compact type toggle, number keypads and a sticky Calculate bar will cut time to price on phones and lift completion.
abTests.variant: Segmented Domestic | International, inputmode=decimal, sticky Calculate bar
